## Closed

- The SciFact mapping remains diagnostic rather than being promoted into governance gold.
- The confirmatory target uses 30 independent external families across executable software, kernel-checked proofs and reproducible workflows.
- Protected validity comes from native/pre-existing objective verifiers whose outcomes remain hidden until policy receipts are immutable.
- Natural/source-authored invalids are mandatory; planted corruptions are calibration controls only.
- Full ORION is compared against the strongest matched-information multi-review comparator with family-level inference.
- Any full-ORION severe false promotion on the frozen external invalid set is an adverse terminal that cost or average accuracy cannot rescue.
- The comparator gate is >=21/30 family wins and >=6/10 per object class; within-family objects cannot inflate N.
- Workflow artifact integrity is explicitly separated from recomputation of a named scientific result/invariant.

## Still open

- freeze/acquisition of 30 eligible independent families and >=60 target external invalid objects;
- protected objective-verifier execution;
- exact false-promotion denominator and uncertainty after unblinding;
- external interpretation, novelty and venue authority.

A favourable result would support governance transfer across the three registered **objective-verifier regimes**. It would not by itself establish unrestricted scientific truth or institutional authority.
